sections.overview: Hero intro: large heading, subheading, two CTA buttons on the left; a stacked cluster of three lifestyle images on the right.

sequences.description: Large H1 heading, supporting subheading paragraph, and two call-to-action buttons (primary 'See case', secondary 'All stories'), alongside a group of three cover images.

sections.overview: Case-study intro: a large 3x2 cover image beside a text column containing breadcrumbs, an H2 heading, and author/date/read-time byline.

sequences.description: Side-by-side layout: cover image on one side; on the other side breadcrumbs (Home / Case studies), an H2 heading, and byline metadata (author name, date, read time).

sections.overview: 'Style in every snapshot' gallery: centered heading and subtext followed by a responsive grid of eight square lifestyle images.

sequences.description: Centered H2 heading ('Style in every snapshot') with a supporting paragraph ('Peek the latest looks in action').
Responsive grid of eight square (1x1) cover images, no text per item — a photo gallery.

sections.overview: Interactive profile/testimonial tabs: a large content panel (portrait image + name, role, quote) switchable via four tab buttons, each showing an avatar, name, and role.

sequences.description: Tabbed interface with four switchable panels. Each panel shows a person's photo, name, role, and a testimonial quote. Tab menu buttons show avatar + name + role.

sections.overview: 'Latest articles' listing: centered heading and subtext followed by a grid of four article cards, each with an image, category tag, date, and title, linking to a blog post.

sequences.description: Centered H2 heading ('Latest articles') with supporting paragraph ('Fresh looks, bold moves').
Grid of four article cards; each card is a link containing an image, a category tag, a date, and a title heading.

sections.overview: FAQ section: an H2 heading and subheading beside an expandable list of four question/answer items (details/summary).

sequences.description: H2 heading ('Got questions? We've got answers.') and supporting subheading ('Fashion FAQs, answered fast').
Expandable list of four question-and-answer items; each row has a clickable question and a collapsible answer paragraph.

sections.background: dark (inverse-section) with full-bleed background image and overlay
sections.layout: full-width banner with background image + overlaid text
sections.overview: Closing CTA banner: full-bleed background image with a dark overlay, an overlaid H1 heading, subheading, and a single call-to-action button ('See more').

sequences.description: Full-width banner with a background image and dark overlay; overlaid H1 heading, subheading paragraph, and one call-to-action button.
